title: Rational scalar object transport
statement: For an identity integral scalar functor whose underlying included functor equals completed integral scalar extension, rational scalar extension maps the localization of an integral object to the localization of the scalar functor object.

source.place: Rationalization object formula in the identity scalar-extension paragraph.

proof.text: Apply the defining object equation for sfRationalScalarExtension, then apply congrArg to the rational localization functor and use the object equality hS on K.

lean.statement:
theorem rational_scalar_object_transport
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) (T : Scheme.{max u v})
    (S : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) ⥤ C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E))
    (hS : S ⋙ RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) =
      RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E) ⋙
        integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E.carrier E.carrier
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω T (.integral E)) :
    (rationalScalar.{u, v} l Ω E E (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E.carrier) T).obj
        ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E T).obj K) =
      (rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E T).obj (S.obj K)
